question: How does union with the power-wheel dissolve the universe?
premises: In union of the power-wheel, dissolution of the universe is what Bhairava said: the nature of rising as self from supreme consciousness.
As inner target and outer vision self, order and disorder pervade the whole power-wheel.
Order cuts the appearance of creation, preservation, and dissolution; disorder is their simultaneous appearance.
Supreme consciousness touches and flashes as the body of order and disorder, transcending the three orders.
By transcending that, the supreme goddess consciousness flashes, even when called both thin and full, as unsurpassed freedom-power.
In that union, proper order-reflection included in light-reflection makes dissolution of the universe, though situated as body and external, become supreme consciousness fire.
Thus all principles dissolve into consciousness; see consciousness abiding in the body, glowing like time-fire.
The thing without utterance is the form of supreme speech, so non-utterance is the seat of utterance.
Immediately after the light known through the power-wheel, reflecting such known reflection only is the śākta means.
By mind alone, thinking thus, one attains absorption called śākta.
This is established indirectly; through worship of the true guru's feet, manifestation comes.
Union with the power-wheel is not excessively manifested.
This is summarized by the first and last verses; thus in the withdrawn universe there is no difference between absorption and emergence.
inference: Union with the power-wheel dissolves the universe by transforming its ordered and disordered appearances into supreme consciousness, so that all principles are absorbed into consciousness without distinction between absorption and emergence.

plain_english: In union with the power-wheel, the dissolution of the universe is the rising of the self from supreme consciousness, as Bhairava said. Order and disorder pervade the whole power-wheel: order cuts the appearances of creation, preservation, and dissolution, while disorder is their simultaneous appearance. Supreme consciousness touches and flashes as the body of order and disorder, transcending the three orders; by transcending them, the supreme goddess consciousness flashes, even when called both thin and full, as unsurpassed freedom-power. In that union, proper reflection on order, included within light and reflection, makes the universe, though situated as body and external, become supreme consciousness fire. Thus all principles dissolve into consciousness; see consciousness abiding in the body, glowing like time-fire. The thing without utterance is the form of supreme speech, so non-utterance is the seat of utterance. Immediately after the light known through the power-wheel, reflecting such known reflection only is the śākta means; by mind alone, thinking thus, one attains absorption called śākta. This is established indirectly, and through worship of the true guru's feet manifestation comes. Union with the power-wheel is not excessively manifested. This is summarized by the first and last verses; thus in the withdrawn universe there is no difference between absorption and emergence.
